name: skuld
description: a Skuld, one of the Doviello's greatest warriors, reborn at the oak of Urslo: an old warrior with long wild grey hair and a long grey beard woven with green leaves, blue eyes, a grey wolf pelt worn as a cloak with the wolf's head on his right shoulder, a blue-grey scale vest, a gold torc and gold chain necklace, a red sash hanging at the front, brown leather bracers, grey fur leggings and brown fur boots, and a long-hafted bearded battle-axe with a broad steel blade, gripped by the low end of its haft in his RIGHT hand
hands: the battle-axe's haft end stays in his right hand on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the haft high up, just below the axe head, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the haft, the long battle-axe is lifted high beside the head with its steel head pointing up
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the axe hand behind the head and the long battle-axe hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, its steel head low behind him, the left hand an empty fist tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the axe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the battle-axe is level, its steel head pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: axe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the battle-axe's broad steel blade chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the battle-axe carries on down until its blade nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the long grey hair, beard and wolf pelt trailing back, the empty left fist trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the battle-axe comes back up across the chest toward its resting angle, slanting up to the right with its steel head raised high, the left hand reaching for the haft

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, beard flying, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (axe arm thrown up and out to the left with the battle-axe pointing up, the empty left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the battle-axe's haft held up across the body, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, axe arm flung up holding the battle-axe high, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the battle-axe lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the battle-axe's blade resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the battle-axe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the long grey hair and the wolf pelt spread under him; the battle-axe lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the long grey beard and the wolf pelt settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the grey beard on his chest, the battle-axe on the ground beside him
